name: Samophlange (item)
summary: In the Barrens, Samophlange is hidden inside an automated control console. Goblin mechanics cannot explain what the strange component does.

sections.title: A Baffling Contraption
sections.body: Samophlange lies inside a control console in the Barrens, behind a maze of wiring and hollow tubes. It takes careful searching to free the component from its housing. It looks like a vital part of clockwork and steam machinery, but goblin tinkerers cannot make sense of its purpose. They mean to send it to the Tinkers' Union in Undermine, though the fragile piece may not survive rough handling.

sections.title: Curiosity and Catastrophe
sections.body: Sputtervalve, an engineer in Ratchet, plans to send Samophlange to senior minds in the Tinkers' Union for study. Goblin curiosity gets in the way of that plan. When Sputtervalve sets the delicate device down to examine its inner workings, it often shatters into scrap.

faq.answer: Samophlange is a strange mechanical component taken from a control console in the Barrens. Its purpose is unknown, and the console around it is crowded with tubes and wires that seem to do nothing useful.

aliases: who do i give the samophlange to
faq.answer: Sputtervalve, an engineer in Ratchet, wants Samophlange brought to him so he can study it and send it to the Tinkers' Union.

faq.q: What does Sputtervalve do with it?
faq.answer: Sputtervalve plans to send Samophlange to Undermine for study by the Tinkers' Union. He sets it down to inspect it first, and the fragile mechanism breaks.

faq.q: Where did the samophlange come from?
faq.answer: Samophlange is housed inside an operating console in the northern Barrens, behind layers of confusing, seemingly useless machinery.

angles.text: As an engineer, you may recognize Samophlange as an overcomplicated design. Its intricate exterior hides a mechanism so fragile that it breaks when set on the floor.
